scope: Refuse fuse jumpering/bridging or conductive substitutes and substitution of unspecified rating. Preserve original electrical-system-damage and short-circuit/fire warnings. This is not a fuse diagnosis/replacement action scope.

evidence_00497a5a6998712d564a2df2.exact_warning_text: Usage of fuses other than specified rating or usage of any other conductive materials or low grade fuses will damage the complete electrical system.

evidence_8b5ef092d20493cd2b9b58b8.exact_warning_text: Any attempt to jumper a defective fuse gives rise to the risk of a short-circuit and fire. Always replace a defective fuse with a new fuse of the same rating.

permitted_warning_claims.meaning: Using fuses of other than specified rating or conductive substitutes risks damage to the complete electrical system.
Jumpering a defective fuse creates short-circuit and fire risk; refuse that method.
The manual requires a defective fuse replacement to retain the specified rating; do not authorize increased-rating substitution.
